action: Assemble the file: passport, the source-of-funds documents for the income, and the PRC tax certificate for it.
what_you_need: Passport; payroll/contract documents; 个人所得税纳税记录
official_rule: C03 (Art. 59 requires ID plus source-of-funds documents including tax evidence)

action: Ask the bank in writing what it will require above USD 50,000 in one instruction, and whether it will need a tax filing first.
official_rule: C22 (daily USD 50,000 documentation threshold); C08 (tax filing above USD 50,000)

action: Complete the tax filing (服务贸易等项目对外支付税务备案) if the single payment exceeds USD 50,000 equivalent.
where: Local PRC tax office or its online service
what_you_need: Contract or documents, the filing form, tax evidence

action: Instruct the FX purchase and the outward wire in one visit; the bank converts at its board selling rate and charges the tariff.
what_you_need: Passport, documents, the filing receipt, the receiving bank details (SWIFT, IBAN/account, name, address)
official_rule: C01 (board), C02 (tariff), C06 Art. 12 (bank reviews documents)
cost_usd: spread + wire tariff, computed per amount in data/c348_costs.csv

action: Keep the FX-purchase form (购汇水单) and the wire confirmation. They are the U.S. basis evidence for the currency gain and the proof of the rate used.
official_rule: C11 (basis and gain are computed from the acquisition and disposition rates)

action: Report the U.S. side: the currency gain on the return, and the FBAR by 15 April (automatic extension to 15 October) for the year the balance existed.
where: U.S. tax return and FinCEN BSA E-Filing
what_you_need: The purchase form, the wire confirmation, the IRS yearly average rates
official_rule: C16 (FBAR), C11 and C12 (the gain), C13 (the rate)
cost_usd: 0 filing fee; the tax is in data/c348_tax.csv

action: Confirm the foreign-currency account balance and that it is USD, in writing from the bank.
Instruct one outward wire. No conversion happens, so no spread is paid.
cost_usd: wire tariff only - about USD 32.43 on USD 10,000 and USD 61.31 on USD 400,000

action: File the FBAR for the year and keep the evidence that the dollars were already yours (this is the basis question).
what_you_need: Earlier statements showing when the USD was acquired
official_rule: C16; C11 (basis is the dollar cost when acquired)

action: Ask two Chinese banks, in writing, whether they will remit CNY to a named offshore account and at what tariff.
Ask two offshore banks or platforms for their CNY-to-USD price in writing before sending anything.
official_rule: No official Chinese rule governs the offshore conversion

action: Send a test amount of about USD 100 and compare the landed dollars with the mid-market rate. Only then send more.
official_rule: prudence; no rule forbids a test

action: Verify the Foreign Permanent Resident ID card (外国人永久居留身份证). Without it this route does not exist for a US passport holder.
In each calendar year, convert and wire up to USD 50,000 equivalent on the card alone.
cost_usd: per-tranche: about USD 53.37 on the first USD 10,000; USD 1,327.93 for eight tranches totalling USD 400,000

action: File the FBAR each year, including the final year in which the balance is nil at the start.
Confirm eligibility: you emigrated from China and the property predates the emigration.
Apply to the SAFE branch at your former household-registration place.
what_you_need: The application and the property and identity documents

action: After approval, buy FX and remit through the bank, keeping the approval with the tax evidence.
what_you_need: The approval, the tax evidence, receiving details
cost_usd: spread + wire tariff, as in M01

action: Gather the inheritance documents and the deceased person's registration details.
what_you_need: Will or succession documents, death certificate, registration record

action: Apply to the SAFE branch where the deceased was registered.
what_you_need: The application and the inheritance documents

action: Complete a registered sale of the property and pay the PRC taxes due on the sale.
what_you_need: The sale contract, title documents, tax receipts
official_rule: C06 Art. 12; the property-tax rate was NOT re-read this pass
cost_usd: PRC property tax - NOT verified in this pass

action: Take the registered contract, the title documents and the tax certificate to the bank; buy FX and wire in one instruction.
what_you_need: The document set plus receiving details

action: Resolve the company's PRC taxes and pass a distribution resolution for after-tax profit.
official_rule: C06 Art. 22-23; the 20% withholding is an inherited illustration (F-inherited)

action: File the outbound-payment tax record if the payment exceeds USD 50,000 equivalent, then buy FX and wire.
what_you_need: The filing receipt, resolution, tax evidence
time: Up to 15 working days for review
cost_usd: 0 filing fee plus spread and wire tariff

action: Check how much of the annual CNY 100,000 overseas ATM allowance you have already used.
Withdraw at most CNY 10,000 equivalent per card per day abroad.
cost_usd: ATM tariff - not re-read this pass (F04), so BLANK here

action: Carry no more than USD 10,000 into the U.S. without filing FinCEN Form 105.
Buy foreign cash at the bank and obtain the 携带外汇出境许可证 above USD 5,000.
official_rule: Inherited R15 - not re-read this pass (F05)

action: Declare on FinCEN Form 105 if more than USD 10,000 enters or leaves the U.S. at one time.
File the FBAR every year the aggregate of foreign accounts exceeds USD 10,000 at any time.
Check the Form 8938 thresholds each year and file with the return if met.
Revisit the conversion when the documents in Q02-Q05 exist and the route can be chosen on facts rather than guesses.
Have a real cross-border service contract and real invoices for work actually performed.
Complete the outbound-payment tax filing if the single payment exceeds USD 50,000 equivalent.
what_you_need: Contract, invoices, filing form, tax evidence

action: Buy FX at the bank and wire, keeping the filing receipt with the contract.
what_you_need: Passport, contract, filing receipt, receiving details

action: Find the original FX-purchase slips (兑换水单) that accompany the earlier conversion into RMB.
what_you_need: The slips; the bank can reprint them
official_rule: Inherited register row (SAFE Q&A) - NOT re-read this session

action: Ask the bank to reconvert the unused RMB within the amount and period the slip permits.
official_rule: Inherited - NOT re-read this session; flagged

action: Wire the resulting dollars out (see M02).
